gw_mtu.detail.low: S4 = {s4}, the server MTU is now {server} — mobile networks stay fast, but HTTP/3 through this protocol will fall back to TCP. The full fix is new settings with S4 ≤ {s4_max}.
gw_mtu.detail.narrow: The network interface (NIC) MTU is {nic}, but a packet of a client with MTU {client} and S4 = {s4} needs {need} (client MTU + {overhead} + S4). Issue new settings with MTU {new_client} or keep it as is.
gw_mtu.log.server: Server MTU of inbound {kind}: {was} → {now} (NIC {nic}, budget {budget}, S4 = {s4})
gw_mtu.low: {title}: S4 = {s4} — to keep mobile networks fast, the server lowered the MTU to {server}; HTTP/3 through this protocol will fall back to TCP. The full fix is new settings with S4 ≤ {s4_max}.
gw_mtu.narrow: {title}: the server’s network interface MTU ({nic}) is lower than clients with MTU {client} and S4 = {s4} need (a packet needs {need}: client MTU + {overhead} + S4). Issue new settings with MTU {new_client} (the devices will be listed) or keep it as is.
gw_mtu.st.choice: new settings: kaskadctl gw mtu {cmd} {kind} · keep as is: kaskadctl gw mtu keep {kind}
gw_mtu.st.head: MTU: NIC {nic}{dev}, budget {budget}
gw_mtu.st.kept_narrow: network interface MTU too low: kept as is (clients with MTU {client} won’t fit)
gw_mtu.st.kept_s4: S4 = {s4}: kept as is (server {server}, HTTP/3 through the inbound goes over TCP)
gw_mtu.st.low: server MTU below 1232: HTTP/3 through this inbound will fall back to TCP
gw_mtu.st.nic_now: the network interface MTU is now {nic} — applied on kaskadctl gw apply
gw_mtu.manual.kinds: Manual MTU is for WireGuard and AmneziaWG only; {title} has none.
gw_mtu.manual.range: {title}: MTU must be a whole number from {min} to {limit}.
gw_mtu.manual.over: {title}: MTU {limit} at most — otherwise the outer packet exceeds {budget}, and mobile networks and PPPoE slow down on such packets. The server would not go above {server} anyway.
gw_mtu.manual.closed: {title}: manual MTU can’t be changed now — with a network interface MTU of {nic} and S4 = {s4} a packet with MTU {min} is already over {budget} outside. MTU now: {cur}.
